evidence.used: terrace path of tan irregular flagstones, pitted limestone-rock borders, columnar cacti, dragon-tree palms, red euphorbia and purple flowerbeds

evidence.author: kajikawa
evidence.used: hillside garden stepping down the cliff, blue mosaic mural wall, narrow stairs and white railings, view over the harbour
garden extent only (169 x 108 m on a steep slope); a representative terrace group is modelled

review.gaps: representative terraces, not the full slope; columnar cacti are thin arched tubes, flagstones are regular tiled polygons, rock edging is blocky prisms rather than pitted limestone, mural wall is a flat blue slab, planting far sparser than the photo
